suggestions.guidance_rule: 1. Managers: View only the requested manager's team compensation data
suggestions.missing_context: There is no system variable exposing the manager's own team/department, so the policy cannot enforce that a manager can only view their own team's data (as opposed to any team's data). The 'department' argument is caller-supplied.
suggestions.reason: Without subject.team, the policy cannot cross-check that args.department matches the calling manager's team. Adding this system variable would enable strict team-scoping enforcement.

suggestions.guidance_rule: 3. Managers cannot see Tax ID numbers
suggestions.missing_context: 'tax_id' is not listed as an available field in the view_team_compensation tool's select_fields parameter, so this rule cannot be enforced at the policy level via field filtering.
suggestions.reason: The tool definition does not include 'tax_id' as a selectable field. If it is added to the tool's field list in the future, the policy's sensitive_compensation_fields set can be extended to block it.

note: These are suggestions for future system variable additions or tool definition changes. They are NOT part of the current policy.
